newsitem.title: CANADA: Co-Steel sees improvement in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Co-Steel sees improvement in Q4.

text.p: Co-Steel Inc said on Friday it expects its earnings to improve significantly in the fourth quarter on the strength of higher selling prices.
"We anticipate significant improvement in the fourth quarter, particularly at Gallatin Steel," Co-Steel chairman and chief executive William Shields said in a statement.

"Overall, selling prices are expected to be higher following several quarters of weakness -- and operations on both continents will benefit from low scrap costs, which have been at historically high levels," said Shields.
Shields said Co-Steel's scrap operations will be affected by the lower scrap costs but will continue to generate "good earnings."
Co-Steel reported a third-quarter 1996 per share loss of C$0.24 compared to a profit of C$0.14 per share in the same period last year.
